hwdef.dat comment for SPI1 spells the IMU as 'ICM62688' which is a typo; all other references (SPIDEV alias, README, wiki) confirm ICM42688.

ai.pinout_notes: 15 PWM outputs: M1-M8 via IOMCU (STM32F103), A9-A15 via FMU; SERIAL1-7 (Telem1/UART7, Telem2/UART5, GPS1/USART1, GPS2/UART8, Telem3/USART2, User/UART4, Debug/USART3); 2x CAN+CANFD; Ethernet; microSD (SDMMC2); FRAM on SPI5 for parameter storage; IMU heater (1W); SBUS/RC on TIM8
discrepancies: Manufacturer field is null in current data; should be 'ZeroOne' per README/wiki.

Baro chip_display is null and driver alias 'ICP201XX' is used in the JSON imu chip field; the real chip per README and wiki is ICP20100 (ICP201XX is the ArduPilot driver name covering both ICP20100 and ICP20101).

hwdef probes RM3100 and BMM350 compasses on the internal I2C4 bus alongside IST8310, but README and wiki explicitly name only IST8310 as the built-in compass. RM3100/BMM350 entries are likely speculative probing for hardware variants that did not ship.

README and wiki say '6x UART' but hwdef SERIAL_ORDER defines 7 physical UARTs (UART7, UART5, USART1, UART8, USART2, UART4, USART3). The '6' in marketing copy appears to exclude the debug UART (SERIAL7/USART3). Our data uart_count=7 is correct from the hwdef.
Wiki PWM section incorrectly refers to 'STM32H753 FMU controller'; hwdef and all other wiki text correctly identify the chip as STM32H743 (STM32H743IIK6).

hwdef defines 8 FMU PWM outputs (PWM1-PWM8) but README/wiki describe only 7 auxiliary outputs labeled A9-A15; board likely does not externally expose all 8 FMU PWM pads, so effective total is 15 (8 IOMCU + 7 FMU), not 16 as in current data.
The Air variant has 1 IMU and 1 baro; the Air+ variant has 2 IMUs and 2 baros. The hwdef (and current JSON) reflects Air+ configuration with 2 of each. The slug covers both sub-variants.
